model: sig User { follows : set User, sees : set Photo, posts : set Photo, suggested : set User } sig Influencer extends User {} sig Photo { date : one Day } sig Ad extends Photo {} sig Day {}

requirements.description: Every photo is posted by one user
requirements.instances:
// Expect labels apply when the target requirement is enforced during evaluation.
// Exactly one user posts the photo.
run PositiveScenario1 {
  some disj u1: User |
  some disj p1: Photo |
  some disj d1: Day |
    User = u1 and Influencer = none and
    Photo = p1 and Ad = none and Day = d1 and
    (User <: follows) = none->none and
    (User <: sees) = none->none and
    (User <: posts) = u1->p1 and
    (User <: suggested) = none->none and
    (Photo <: date) = p1->d1
} for 1 but exactly 1 User, exactly 1 Photo, exactly 1 Day expect 1

// Each of two photos, including an ad, is posted by exactly one user.
run PositiveScenario2 {
  some disj u1, u2: User |
  some disj p1, p2: Photo |
  some disj d1, d2: Day |
    User = u1 + u2 and Influencer = u2 and
    Photo = p1 + p2 and Ad = p2 and Day = d1 + d2 and
    (User <: follows) = none->none and
    (User <: sees) = none->none and
    (User <: posts) = u1->p1 + u2->p2 and
    (User <: suggested) = none->none and
    (Photo <: date) = p1->d1 + p2->d2
} for 2 but exactly 2 User, exactly 2 Photo, exactly 2 Day expect 1

// A photo is posted by one of two users; the other user follows and sees.
run PositiveScenario3 {
  some disj u1, u2: User |
  some disj p1: Photo |
  some disj d1: Day |
    User = u1 + u2 and Influencer = none and
    Photo = p1 and Ad = none and Day = d1 and
    (User <: follows) = u1->u2 and
    (User <: sees) = u1->p1 and
    (User <: posts) = u2->p1 and
    (User <: suggested) = none->none and
    (Photo <: date) = p1->d1
} for 2 but exactly 2 User, exactly 1 Photo, exactly 1 Day expect 1

// The photo has no posting user.
run NegativeScenario1 {
  some disj u1: User |
  some disj p1: Photo |
  some disj d1: Day |
    User = u1 and Influencer = none and
    Photo = p1 and Ad = none and Day = d1 and
    (User <: follows) = none->none and
    (User <: sees) = none->none and
    (User <: posts) = none->none and
    (User <: suggested) = none->none and
    (Photo <: date) = p1->d1
} for 1 but exactly 1 User, exactly 1 Photo, exactly 1 Day expect 0

// The same photo is posted by two different users.
run NegativeScenario2 {
  some disj u1, u2: User |
  some disj p1: Photo |
  some disj d1: Day |
    User = u1 + u2 and Influencer = u2 and
    Photo = p1 and Ad = none and Day = d1 and
    (User <: follows) = none->none and
    (User <: sees) = none->none and
    (User <: posts) = u1->p1 + u2->p1 and
    (User <: suggested) = none->none and
    (Photo <: date) = p1->d1
} for 2 but exactly 2 User, exactly 1 Photo, exactly 1 Day expect 0

// One photo is posted, but the other photo has no posting user.
run NegativeScenario3 {
  some disj u1: User |
  some disj p1, p2: Photo |
  some disj d1: Day |
    User = u1 and Influencer = none and
    Photo = p1 + p2 and Ad = p2 and Day = d1 and
    (User <: follows) = none->none and
    (User <: sees) = none->none and
    (User <: posts) = u1->p1 and
    (User <: suggested) = none->none and
    (Photo <: date) = p1->d1 + p2->d1
} for 1 but exactly 1 User, exactly 2 Photo, exactly 1 Day expect 0

requirements.description: Users cannot follow themselves

 // PositiveScenario1 has no self-follow edge; its photo is posted by one user.

  some disj u0: User, disj p0: Photo, disj d0: Day |
    User = u0 and Influencer = none and
    Photo = p0 and Ad = none and Day = d0 and

    (User <: suggested) = none->none and

requirements.description: Users can see ads posted by everyone, but only see non ads posted by followed users
requirements.instances:
// Expect labels apply when the target requirement is enforced; each valuation otherwise satisfies the model and the two background requirements.
// PositiveScenario1: Both users see the ad; a user who follows the non-ad's poster also sees that non-ad.
run PositiveScenario1 {
  some disj u, v: User | some disj a, n: Photo | some d: Day |
    User = u + v and Influencer = u and
    Photo = a + n and Ad = a and Day = d and
    (User <: follows) = (u->v) + (v->u) and
    (User <: sees) = (u->a) + (u->n) + (v->a) and
    (User <: posts) = (u->a) + (v->n) and
    (User <: suggested) = none->none and
    (Photo <: date) = (a->d) + (n->d)
} for 2 but exactly 2 User, exactly 2 Photo, exactly 1 Day expect 1

// PositiveScenario2: The sole user sees the ad; there are no non-ads.
run PositiveScenario2 {
  some x: User | some a: Photo | some d: Day |
    User = x and Influencer = none and
    Photo = a and Ad = a and Day = d and
    (User <: follows) = none->none and
    (User <: sees) = x->a and
    (User <: posts) = x->a and
    (User <: suggested) = none->none and
    (Photo <: date) = a->d
} for 1 but exactly 1 User, exactly 1 Photo, exactly 1 Day expect 1

// PositiveScenario3: All users see the ad; the influencer sees a non-ad posted by a user she follows.
run PositiveScenario3 {
  some disj r, s, t: User | some disj a, n: Photo | some disj d1, d2: Day |
    User = r + s + t and Influencer = t and
    Photo = a + n and Ad = a and Day = d1 + d2 and
    (User <: follows) = (r->s) + (t->s) and
    (User <: sees) = (r->a) + (s->a) + (t->a) + (t->n) and
    (User <: posts) = (r->a) + (s->n) and
    (User <: suggested) = s->r and
